hw_name.description: This is the Floatwheel BMS.

controller_id.description: BMS ID. Used to identify this VESC BMS on the CAN-bus.

can_baud_rate.description: CAN-bus baud rate.

can_status_rate_hz.description: Send status messages on the CAN-bus at this rate.

cell_num.description: Number of cells in series.

balance_mode.description:
Cell Balancing Mode. Options:


BALANCE_MODE_DISABLED

Do not balance cells at all.


BALANCE_MODE_CHARGING_ONLY

Only balance while charging.


BALANCE_MODE_ALWAYS

Always allow balancing.

vc_charge_min.description:
Absolute minimum allowed cell voltage.


The BMS will only allow charging if all cell voltages are above this voltage.


The pack is considered dead if any cell voltage is below this voltage.

vc_charge_start.description:
Minimum usable cell voltage.


When the minimum cell voltage is above this voltage, the BMS will clear the Low Voltage status and restore previously cut power.

vc_charge_end.description:
Maximum allowed cell voltage.


When the maximum cell voltage is above this voltage, for the amount of time set by High Voltage Delay, the BMS will set the High Voltage status and stop charging.


The High Voltage status is cleared and charging re-enabled when all cell voltages drop below this voltage, if not balancing.


This setting can be used to limit the maximum charge.

vc_discharge_min.description:
Minimum allowed discharge cell voltage.


When the minimum cell voltage is below this voltage, for the amount of time set by Low Voltage Delay, the BMS will set the Low Voltage status and CUT POWER.


The Low Voltage status is cleared and power restored when all cells are charged to at least Charge Start Voltage.

vc_balance_min.description: Only allow balancing if all cells are above this voltage.

vc_balance_start.description: Start balancing if cell voltage is this much above the minimum cell voltage.

vc_balance_end.description: Stop balancing when cell voltage is this much above the minimum cell voltage.

vc_balance_high_threshold_delta.description: Only drain cells that are this close to the maximum cell voltage.

t_min.description:
Minimum allowed battery temperature.


When the battery temperature is below this temperature, the BMS will set the Low Temperature status.


The Low Temperature status is cleared and charging re-enabled when the battery temperature rises above Charge Low Threshold Temperature (Battery), or if not charging and the battery temperature rises above Low Threshold Temperature (Battery).

t_low_threshold.description:
Safe battery temperature threshold.


The Low Temperature status is cleared, if not charging, when the battery temperature rises above this temperature.

t_charge_min.description:
Minimum allowed battery temperature for charging.


When the battery temperature is below this temperature and the charger is connected, the BMS will set the Low Temperature status and prevent charging.


The Low Temperature status is cleared and charging re-enabled when the battery temperature rises above Charge Low Threshold Temperature (Battery), or if not charging and the battery temperature rises above Low Threshold Temperature (Battery).

t_charge_low_threshold.description:
Safe battery temperature threshold for charging.


The Low Temperature status is cleared and charging re-enabled when the battery temperature rises above this temperature.

t_charge_max.description:
Maximum allowed battery temperature.


When the battery temperature is above this temperature, for the amount of time set by High Temperature Delay, the BMS will set the High Temperature status and stop charging.


The High Temperature status is cleared and charging re-enabled when the battery temperature falls below Charge High Threshold Temperature (Battery) and the BMS temperature falls below Charge High Threshold Temperature (BMS).

t_charge_high_threshold.description:
Safe battery temperature threshold.


The High Temperature status is cleared and charging re-enabled when the battery temperature falls below this temperature and the BMS temperature falls below Charge High Threshold Temperature (BMS).

t_bms_charge_max.description:
Maximum allowed BMS temperature.


When the BMS temperature is above this temperature, for the amount of time set by High Temperature Delay, the BMS will set the High Temperature status and stop charging.


The High Temperature status is cleared and charging re-enabled when the battery temperature falls below Charge High Threshold Temperature (Battery) and the BMS temperature falls below Charge High Threshold Temperature (BMS).

t_bms_charge_high_threshold.description:
Safe BMS temperature threshold.


The High Temperature status is cleared and charging re-enabled when the battery temperature falls below Charge High Threshold Temperature (Battery) and the BMS temperature falls below this temperature.

min_charge_current.description:
Safe charge current threshold.


The High Charge Current status is cleared and charging re-enabled when charge current falls below this current, for the amount of time set by High Charge Current Reset Delay.

max_charge_current.description:
Maximum allowed charge current.


When the charge current is above this current, the BMS will set the High Charge Current status and stop charging.


The High Charge Current status is cleared and charging re-enabled when charge current falls below Minimum Charge Current, for the amount of time set by High Charge Current Reset Delay.

max_discharge_current.description:
Maximum allowed discharge current.


When discharge current is greater than this current, set the High Discharge Current status. The BMS will CUT POWER if discharge current stays greater than this current, for the amount of time set by High Discharge Current Delay.


The High Discharge Current status is cleared and power restored when discharge current falls below this current.

balance_max_current.description: Only allow balancing when the current magnitude is below this value.

short_circuit_detection_voltage.description:
Voltage threshold for the BMS IC built in short circuit detection. If the BMS detects this voltage for the amount of time set by Short-Circuit Detection Time, it will CUT POWER.


1 mV here is approvimately equivalent to 1 A current.


This value is rounded to the nearest 10 mV, so it's recommended to read the config after writing to see what the actual used value will be.

overvoltage_delay.description:
When the maximum cell voltage is above Charge End Voltage, for this amount of time, the BMS will set the High Voltage status and stop charging.


The High Voltage status is cleared and charging re-enabled when all cell voltages fall below Charge End Voltage, if not balancing.

undervoltage_delay.description:
When the minimum cell voltage is below Discharge Minimum Voltage, for this amount of time, the BMS will set the Low Voltage status and CUT POWER.


The Low Voltage status is cleared and power restored when all cells are charged to at least Charge Start Voltage.

charge_overcurrent_reset_delay.description: The High Charge Current status is cleared and charging re-enabled when charge current falls below Minimum Charge Current, for this amount of time.

discharge_overcurrent_delay.description:
When discharge current is greater than Maximum Discharge Current, for this amount of time, the BMS will CUT POWER.


The High Discharge Current status is cleared and power restored when discharge current falls below Maximum Discharge Current.

short_circuit_detection_time.description:
Time threshold for the BMS IC built in short circuit detection. If the BMS detects a voltage of Short-Circuit Detection Voltage, for this amount of time, it will CUT POWER.


This value is rounded to the nearest 7.8125 μs, so it's recommended to read the config after writing to see what the actual used value will be.

overtemperature_delay.description:
When the battery temperature is above Charge Maximum Temperature (Battery) or the BMS temperature is above Charge Maximum Temperature (BMS), for this amount of time, the BMS will set the High Temperature status and stop charging.


The High Temperature status is cleared and charging re-enabled when the battery temperature falls below Charge High Threshold Temperature (Battery) and the BMS temperature falls below Charge High Threshold Temperature (BMS).
